title: Qwen APP supports Aliyun Token Plan access
excerpt: On August 25, the Tongyi APP and PC version launched the Aliyun Token Plan access feature. After binding the API Key, Tongyi can directly use the Token Plan sub
content_html:
On August 25, the Tongyi APP and PC version launched the Aliyun Token Plan access feature. After binding the API Key, Tongyi can directly use the Token Plan subscription quota when handling complex work tasks.

Users just need to add the Token Plan API Key in the "Work Assistant" to complete the binding. After binding, when using the "Work Assistant" to perform complex tasks such as operating the computer and browser, calling skills to deliver office documents, applications, and websites, the Token Plan subscription quota can be used directly. Tokens will be deducted directly from the user's own Alibaba Cloud BaiLian account.
